jobs.prompt: In tools/autopilot-ready-deps.mjs the early-exit timer of the spawned go --scope child is now unref'd. That makes the tests in tests/autopilot-ready-deps.test.mjs fail with 'Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved' (startScope tests, readyAutopilotDeps memory tests and others, about 13 tests) because a fake child that never exits leaves nothing keeping the event loop alive. Fix in the production code, not by editing existing tests: remove the unref call on that early-exit timer (the window is only 1.5 s, so holding the loop open is harmless) but keep clearTimeout when exit or error settles first. Keep the log-file stderr handling and everything else unchanged. Then make sure the whole of tests/autopilot-ready-deps.test.mjs and tests/autopilot-lock-parent.test.mjs pass; if the test that checks the timer is cleared asserts unref, change only that assertion to check clearTimeout.
